_note: Pre-authentication screen only. It is rendered before the participant's locale is known, so it is deliberately language-neutral English (section 13.4). The printed cards must use the same two words: Login and Password.
_layout_note: The screen is two fields and a button, nothing else: no heading and no instruction line. The messages below are shown only when something goes wrong.

login.invalid: Login or Password is not correct. Try again.
login.busy: A lot of people are signing in at once. Wait a moment and try again - your Login is fine.
